info.name: Factset Analytics Datastore About Account API
Factset Redirects to the Raw Ppt/pdf Output Created by the Publisher Service.

params.name: document
params.description: The Publisher document containing the report

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account ID

params.name: date
params.description: The as of date for the report

items.docs:
Takes report parameter inputs and returns the object location for the specified report via a 302 redirect.

Note: Due to Swagger UI functionality, the redirect is automatically followed when using 'Try it out', so instead of the 302 Header response, a 200 is returned with the Cargo response Body.

params.name: document
params.description: The Analytics Datafeed document containing the report

params.name: assetName
params.description: The PA/SPAR asset name and extension

params.name: reportId
params.description: The PA/SPAR report ID

params.name: tileId
params.description: The PA/SPAR tile ID

params.name: accountId
params.description: The account ID

params.name: configId
params.description: The Vault configuration ID

params.name: date
params.description: The as of date for the report

items.docs:
The inclusion of a configId in the path indicates this is for Insight/Vault mappings only, as PA/SPAR mappings do not support the concept of configuration id.

Takes report parameter inputs and returns the object location for the specified report via a 302 redirect.

Note: Due to Swagger UI functionality, the redirect is automatically followed when using 'Try it out', so instead of the 302 Header response, a 200 is returned with the Cargo response Body.
